## Invitations

During the reporting period, 6803 people were invited to attend. Of these, 5036 attended, giving an attendance rate of 74.0 per cent. This represents the recorded participation for the outreach activity and provides the basis for reviewing engagement with invitations.

The attendance result will support ongoing monitoring of responses from invited people. It also indicates the number of people who attended compared with the total number invited.

## Contact

SMS contact was used for 5782 invitations. A reminder message was also received by 5782 people. These figures show the extent to which text messaging formed part of the contact approach.

Staff continue to phone people who missed appointments, helping maintain contact with those who did not attend. The combined use of invitations, SMS messages, reminders and follow-up calls supports continued outreach.

Prepared by G. Evans.
